svg.title: A blocking tray must move first
svg.desc: Root tray R at P17 must reach bay B21. Its exits via P15 and P20 are occupied, so AGV A first relocates blocker K from P15 to P19, then fetches R and carries it to B21.
svg.metadata: ["Start: root tray R at P17 must reach bay B21. P17 connects only to P15, P20 and charger C16; K holds P15, T20 holds P20 and C16 is a dead end, so R is boxed in. AGV A waits at W13.", "\u2460 AgvMove A: drive unloaded W13 -> P15 and lift the blocker K.", "\u2461 TrayMove K: carry K from P15 to the free stall P19, off R's way out. P15 is now free.", "\u2462 AgvMove A: lower K at P19, drive back unloaded P19 -> P15 -> P17 and lift R. This must wait for \u2461, because P15 was occupied until then.", "\u2463 TrayMove R: carry R out via P15, W13, W18, W22 and W41 into bay B21.", "BayTransition B21: R is lowered in the bay and the bay can switch to retrieve, handing the car to the customer. It depends on \u2463.", "The whole plan at once: starting positions, K's new home P19, and the four moves in the order the planner must respect."]
